red_flags: Reviews are overwhelmingly 5-star with very similar positive tone (best, top instructor, passed first try), which can over-represent successful outcomes.
A meaningful share of the Google reviews are rating-only or one-word ('jiid jidan'/'mumtaza') with no substantive text.

Single-platform footprint: real review text only found on Google (via the school's Trustindex-verified widget and aggregators like rijloket); no klantenvertellen, Trustpilot, or Trustoo presence and Facebook shows 0 reviews.
Objective CBR data contradicts the glowing tone: first-time pass rate ~32% and herexamen ~47% (city average ~50-56%), i.e. below average, despite reviews claiming a high success rate.
review_summary: Across ~11 readable Google reviews students consistently praise the instructor(s) (Ahmad, and a coach named Saif) as patient, clear and good at calming nervous learners, with several reporting they passed the CBR exam on the first try; multiple reviews are written in English by expat learners and the school explicitly teaches in Dutch, Arabic and English. The picture is uniformly glowing but thin and single-platform, and the actual CBR pass statistics are below the city average, so treat the 5.0 rating with some caution.
